title: festuca littoralis
intro: Festuca littoralis, commonly known as littoral fescue, is a type of flowering plant that belongs to the Poaceae family. This plant is known for its potential health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which can help to soothe and calm the body and mind. The therapeutic actions of Festuca littoralis include its ability to reduce anxiety and stress, promote relaxation, and improve sleep quality. The bioactive constituents of this plant include sesquiterpenes, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and health benefits.
